text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during training. As Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi's routine was nearing its end—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeeess! Let's keep this momentum for one 
more lap! ¡Vamos, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
One more lap? You've already finished 
today's training, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No-no!
El still has plenty of energy left! 
The strong must always give it their all, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Put that way, I suppose I can't back 
down. Very well. Just one lap, alright?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—I've decided! I'm going to do extra 
training!!

obviously~ Ahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi safely 
completed her training.
I feel glad I gave 
her a firm reminder at the end,
just to be sure.
